findings.highlight: Everything I see is cursed, whether physical or spiritual.
findings.evidenceJa: 肉眼であろうが心眼であろうが、今の私を見る事自体が呪い
findings.governingReading: 肉眼/心眼 describe the observer’s means of seeing her; 今の私を見る事自体 is the curse.
findings.explanation: Seeing Rider with physical or mental vision becomes everything she sees, physical or spiritual, being cursed.
